title: Suspect Fleeing Police at High Speed Causes Multi-Car Crash
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Los Angeles, California — On November 23, 2024, at around 1:30 p.m., West Valley Division Patrol officers located a stolen white 2022 Mercedes-Benz GLE, parked near the intersection of Corbin Avenue and Sherman Way. After monitoring the vehicle for approximately 2 hours, two occupants entered the vehicle and drove away. The officers began to follow the stolen Mercedes and requested the assistance of additional Patrol units, an air unit and a supervisor. As the following continued Northbound on Desoto Avenue, an additional unit joined the following. The driver of the stolen Mercedes then turned eastbound on Parthenia Street, momentarily pulled over to the curb, stopped and dropped off a female passenger. 

The driver of the stolen Mercedes SUV was later identified, as 42-year-old Kevin Larrea. Larrea then quickly accelerated away at a high rate of speed, eastbound on Parthenia Street, as the officers initiated a vehicle Pursuit, shortly thereafter Larrea turned Southbound on Mason Avenue and continued to flee at a high rate of speed. As Larrea neared the intersection of Mason Avenue and Saticoy Street and moments after the initiation of the pursuit, he ran through a red phase trite and collided with a Tesla Model 3, traveling westbound on Saticoy Street. The force of the impact caused the stolen Mercedes to overturn and collide with a Jaguar XE and a Toyota Corolla, traveling eastbound on Saticoy Street. Following the collisions, the officers extracted Larrea from the overturned stolen Mercedes and were able to take him into custody without further incident. 

Larrea was found to be in possession of crystal methamphetamine and marijuana. Los Angeles Fire Department paramedics responded to the scene and pronounced the female driver of the Tesla deceased at scene. The driver of the Toyota Corolla was transported to a local hospital to be treated for the injuries he sustained, as a result of the traffic crash. The driver of the Jaguar XE, was transported to a local hospital to be treated for injuries, she sustained as a result of the traffic crash. Larrea was transported to a local hospital to be treated for the injuries he sustained as a result of the traffic crash. After receiving treatment at the hospital Larrea was cleared for booking by medical staff. Larrea was arrested for felony evading causing death. 

On November 26, 2024, Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office filed the following charges against Larrea:
- One count of Murder
- One count of Felony Evading Causing Death
- One count of Driving or Taking a Vehicle without Owner's Consent
- One count of Felony Evading-Driving Against Traffic
